program:
app "Attendance" users slate
table lecture subject pick Maths|Physics|Chemistry|English = Maths, went bool = yes
setting minimum num = 75 "Minimum attendance %"
each options lecture.subject as s
  let pct = count(lecture where subject = s and went = yes) * 100 / max(count(lecture where subject = s), 1)
  stack card gap 1
    row
      s bold grow
      round(pct) "%" bold color if(pct < minimum, bad, good)
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, pct, 4 fill if(pct < minimum, bad, good) radius 2
    row gap 1
      button "Went" tap add lecture subject = s, went = yes
      button "Bunked" tap add lecture subject = s, went = no
describe:
Attendance, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- lecture: subject: one of Maths, Physics, Chemistry, English, starts at Maths; went: yes or no, starts at yes. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Minimum attendance %": number, starts at 75.
Shows:
- for each choice of the subject of the lecture:
  - text: the choice.
  - text: pct rounded, "%".
  - a drawing made of rectangles.
  - a button "Went"; a tap adds a lecture with subject set to the choice, went set to yes.
  - a button "Bunked"; a tap adds a lecture with subject set to the choice, went set to no.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words

program:
app "Salon products" star mint
table product_s name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(product_s, it.qty <= it.low)
short "products running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each product_s where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(product_s, it.qty * it.price) faint
form product_s
remind "Check your products" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Salon products, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- product s: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the product s have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "products running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each product s where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the product s for editing; a swipe removes the product s, with undo:
    - text: the name of the product s.
    - text: the kind of the product s.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the product s.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the product s to the qty of the product s minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the product s.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the product s to the qty of the product s plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the product s.
- a form to add a product s.
Reminder "Check your products" at 9:00 on Sat.

fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words

program:
app "Ludo" dice ocean
table point team pick Red|Blue, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Red)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Blue)
setting winat num = 50 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Red" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Red, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Red, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Blue" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Blue, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Blue, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Red win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Blue win!" head color good
list point
describe:
Ludo, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Red, Blue; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 50.
Works out:

app "Habits" check ocean

table check habit ref habit

let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0

each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

program:
app "Cleaning supplies" home ocean
table cleaner name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10
let short = count(cleaner, it.qty <= it.low)
short "supplies running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each cleaner sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form cleaner
describe:
Cleaning supplies, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- cleaner: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 10. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the cleaner have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "supplies running low".
- for each cleaner sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the cleaner for editing; a swipe removes the cleaner, with undo:
    - text: the name of the cleaner.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the cleaner to the qty of the cleaner minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the cleaner.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the cleaner to the qty of the cleaner plus 1.
- a form to add a cleaner.

program:
app "Kids chores" home mint
table chore name text, part pick Morning|Afternoon|Evening = Morning
table chore_done chore ref chore
let n = count(chore)
count(chore_done today) "of" n "done today" head
each chore
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      it.part faint
    toggle it.chore_done
form chore
stat round(count(chore_done week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% done this week"
describe:
Kids chores, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- chore: name: text; part: one of Morning, Afternoon, Evening, starts at Morning. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- chore done: chore: a chore. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- n is how many chore entries.
Shows:
- text: how many chore done entries today, "of", n, "done today".
- for each chore:
  - a group; a tap opens the chore for editing; a swipe removes the chore, with undo:
    - text: its name.
    - text: its part.
    - a tick box for its chore done.
- a form to add a chore.
- a big number: how many chore done entries this week times 100 divided by the result of n times the weekday number of today rounded, labelled "% done this week".
